title: Degree-zero cocycles identify localized chain maps
statement: For a category C with topology J, a commutative ring sheaf R, U in C, and arbitrary cochain complexes L,I of R-modules, assume restriction to C/U preserves zero morphisms. Let S be the evaluated section complex of [def-pur-hom-complex], with its specified product projections pi, and res the termwise restriction. There exists an equivalence e from the degree-zero cycles of S to chain maps res(L) → res(I). For every cycle z, degree p and object W of (C/U)^op, the component (e z)^p at W is the value at W of pi(L,I,0,p,p) evaluated on the included cycle z at U.

proof.text: Obtain the forward function and its prescribed projection formula.
Apply the bijectivity criterion to that function and its formula.
Use Equiv.ofBijective; its forward function is definitionally the original function, so the same formula proves the conclusion.

theorem localizedHomComplex_cycles_aux
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hzero : Functor.PreservesZeroMorphisms
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R) U)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R
    let H := homComplex (R := R) L I
    let π := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (homComplex_exists.{u, v, max u v, max u v} (J := J) (R := R)))
    let S := ((SheafOfModules.forget R₀ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R₀.obj (op U) ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R₀.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj H
    letI := hzero
    let res : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} R₀) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R₀.over U)) ℤ :=
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R₀ U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ e : S.cycles 0 ≃ (res.obj L ⟶ res.obj I),
      (∀ (z : S.cycles 0) (p : ℤ) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ),
        ((e z).f p).val.app W =
          (((π L I 0 p p (add_zero p)).val.app (op U)) (S.iCycles 0 z)).app W)
